Name: Farmhouse Basement Mod
Author: MiniPantsu
Description:
This mod was created for the purpose of adding more space for furnaces, so that they don't take place away from house decorations.
(however you can use the extra space for whatever you'd like.)

6 VERSIONS AVAILABLE:

- Original Version
- Restored Version
- Original Version + Upper Bathroom - [u]Cellar compatible![/u]
- Restored Version + Upper Bathroom - [u]Cellar compatible![/u]
- Original Version + Working Bathroom - Only use if you don't plan on having a cellar!
- Restored Version + Working Bathroom - Only use if you don't plan on having a cellar!

3 VARIATIONS AVAILABLE: (for both versions)

- The original with everything else unchanged
- A variation with only one bed in the nursery (to support my One Bed Mod)
- A variation with an entirely empty nursery (in case you don't want to have kids)


Unlocks with the 2nd house upgrade, you can be both married and unmarried.

Installation instructions included in the file.

Enjoy the new content! :)

Credits to [u]DevilBro[/u] for making the farmhouse_tiles.xnb file as well as the original bathroom design which served as inspiration.
Their version of the farmhouse also includes a mirror for changing appearance.
Link to their mod: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/?
